name: HAMOOBot
name_zh: 北京航墨科技有限公司
summary: HAMOOBot, operated by Beijing Hangmo Technology, develops robot motion and force-control technologies. Its Flexmo joint modules combine gearing, a frameless torque motor, servo drive, elastic elements and absolute encoders for compliant robot actuation. The official portfolio specifies three Star-series and three Titan-series modules; the company also develops complete industrial and exoskeleton robots.
